title: Initial invoice evidence and final period completion
topic: fee invoice initial deadline period credit note refund correction
applicability: Enrolled fee-invoice schedules with line-linked adjustments
content: The customer’s fee-invoice schedule identifies an early required fee line, its first-delivery deadline, and a later complete-period deadline. A partial-period invoice can validly provide early evidence, provided later documents cover every remaining positive net bank-fee line exactly once. Later void/reissue may replace a genuinely delivered early document without erasing its historical delivery. Company name and current buyer address apply to both phases. A scheduled fee refund changes the fee ledger when finalized; it does not rewrite an earlier delivered amount.

provenance.scope: Fictional phased evidence and credit-note terms; not a tax-law claim.
